title: Shady Letter
wikitext:
The '''Shady Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|1|Shady Letter (quest)|Shady Letter|race=HighElf|class=rogue}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Thief, scoundrel, and outlaw: these names defined you before the fall of your homeland.

It seems that fate smiles upon you, for no one shall concern themselves with your past if you are willing to contribute to the greater cause. But I, who remember you, am interested in your change of heart.

Fear not, for my anger has subsided, and I am interested in your ability to endure the darkest aspects of Silvermoon. Join me, and together let us embrace these shadows, for you will never be wealthy, but your hunger will never again consume you.

You will find me to the left of the Golden Ranger.
}}
